scripts.dev: npm run build && supabase start --workdir . && supabase functions serve api --workdir . --env-file ../../.env --no-verify-jwt
scripts.deploy: npm run build && supabase functions deploy api --workdir . && supabase db push --workdir .
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && deno check supabase/functions/api/index.ts || echo 'deno not installed: skipped (CI installs it)'
